additional_info.subject: ID0378687-DC/Si-D/FR-[sXGeRr] Charger Out of Order CRM:00796000786
additional_info.body:
Hello servicesdigitaux.fr@siemens.com,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. We acknowledge the receipt of your inquiry regarding Charger Out of Order. Rest assured that a regional representative will promptly contact you to provide further information.
Below, you will find the relevant asset details:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P8 170000848
Charger ID/Serial No.:
sXGeRr
Problem Description: Charger Out of Order
.
We found in the charger's log that there were many successful charging sessions on September 3rd and that the charger is in a healthy state. The only issue is that the AC outlet has been disabled by the customer. All other outlets are available for charging, and there is no conclusive evidence in the log as to why the HMI is blank.
For future reference, your case number is
0378687
. Please refer to this number in all further communication related to this issue.
We appreciate your time and patience.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
